description: What would happen if someone sent this text, as a comment, a DM, a story reply or a story mention: which live automation starts (or which auto-reply answers a comment) and the messages they'd get, in order. Reads rules the way the live path does: a post's own auto-reply beats an account-wide one, someone who replied STOP or asked for a person gets nothing automated, and with username a conversation they're in moves on. Sends nothing.

post_id.description: As a comment: the post it's on. An automation for one post answers only comments there

username.description: Their Instagram username: fills {name}, and for someone who has DMed before, checks STOP, an open ask for a person and a conversation in progress

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: dm_automation_test
title: Try a DM automation
